description: On Sept. 26 eight panelists spoke to over 200 people and answered questions about health care in Eugene and the state of health care in the area and in Oregon. The Eugene Register Guard ( registerguard.com ) reported on the forum on October 10. Click on picture to read more.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Friends of Nancy Nathanson
title: Citywide forum, concerns over health care — Rep. Nancy Nathanson
